name: Sugarcane Leaf Dataset: Disease Detection and Classification for Machine Learning Applications
description: The Sugarcane Leaf Dataset is a large-scale agricultural computer vision corpus containing 7,134 high-resolution JPEG images (768x1024 pixels at 72 dpi) designed for sugarcane crop health assessment. Gathered via comprehensive field surveys across sugarcane-producing regions in India, the dataset covers 12 distinct classes: 10 major sugarcane foliar diseases (including red rot, rust, yellow leaf disease, mosaic, leaf scorch, eye spot, and ring spot), healthy sugarcane leaves, and dried foliage. Images capture leaves from multiple viewing angles, illumination conditions, and stages of disease severity to ensure robust generalization for machine learning and deep learning models.
